studies.title: Estimation of Kenaf seedling canopy coverage in saline soil using semantic segmentation of UAV RGB images
studies.dataset_name: Kenaf (Hibiscus cannabinus L.) seedlings in saline-alkali soil, UAV RGB

verify.ambiguity: Binary (Kenaf seedling vs soil) IoU 85.99% with SE-U-Net; FCN/U-Net/DeepLabV3+ compared. 'Dice' reported alongside IoU.
verify.quote_in_records: the U-Net architecture was enhanced by incorporating a Self-Attention (SE) channel mechanism, further improving model performance to achieve an IoU of 85.99% and a Dice of 92.44%

verify.ambiguity: F1-score column of Table 4 for SE-UNet AdamW (average over classes). The abstract calls the same value 'an Dice of 92.44%'; for binary segmentation F1 == Dice, recorded under F1. Ablations (Table 5): scale only 91.91, geometric 92.07, photometric 92.17.

verify.quote_in_records: an IoU of 85.99% and a Dice of 92.44%

verify.ambiguity: Overall Accuracy (Acc = (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN)) for SE-UNet AdamW, 92.92%. SE-UNet SGD 92.55%; U-Net SGD 91.91% (per-class Acc U-Net: Kenaf 92.33 / Background 91.49).
verify.quote_in_records: Replacing SGD with AdamW further enhanced SE-UNet's performance, achieving an overall mIoU improvement of 1.7%, accuracy gain of 1.01%, and mF1-score increase of 0.99%

verify.value: None - offline experiments on a high-performance workstation (13th-gen Intel Core i5-13490F, 64 GB DDR4, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070; Python 3.8, CUDA 11.3, PyTorch 1.10). FCN noted as fastest inference for real-time/resource-limited applications, but no embedded deployment or inference FPS reported.
